title: index_capitulation_1x: add record_position_telemetry to monitor() (real-money leg invisible to peak-R telemetry)
roadmap_unmapped_reason: follow-up of INDEX-CAPIT-1X-LEG (map with it at the next weekly pass)
note: Found by lane INDEX-CAPIT-1X-LEG 2026-11-25 (PR #28869 CI): src/units/strategies/index_capitulation_1x.py monitor() runs only the 10-session hold cap and never calls src.runtime.position_telemetry.record_position_telemetry, so tests/test_banking_mechanism_audit.py lists the leg as structurally invisible to peak-R telemetry (n_invisible 5 -> 6, pinned as the measured state, not as acceptable). It trades REAL MONEY on alpaca_live, so its MFE / giveback path is unrecorded; exit-lever research and live-review pricing need that path. Fix (Tier 2, monitor only, no exit change): call record_position_telemetry exactly as e4_oi_shock_1h._telemetry does (swallows everything, observe-only), keep the hold-cap verdict unchanged, and re-run scripts/research/index_capit_live_parity.py, because the parity record pins the module sha1. Done = the leg leaves legs_structurally_invisible (n_invisible back to 5) and /api/diag/position_telemetry shows rows for its first live position.
